title: KestrelCare Transfer Schedule by Coverage Level
content:
KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts may pass to the private buyer of the vehicle at every coverage level except KestrelCare Powertrain. The figures below set whether a plan is transferable, the fee, how many transfers it allows over its life, the request window and whether a dealer buyer may take it.

| Coverage level | Transferable to a private buyer | Transfer fee (USD) | Maximum transfers over the life of the plan | Transfer request window (calendar days after the private sale of the vehicle) | Transfer to a dealer that buys the vehicle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Powertrain | no | 0.00 | 0 | 30 | not allowed |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | yes | 50.00 | 1 | 30 | not allowed |
| KestrelCare Silver | yes | 50.00 | 1 | 30 | not allowed |
| KestrelCare Gold | yes | 50.00 | 1 | 30 | not allowed |
| KestrelCare Platinum | yes | 75.00 | 1 | 30 | not allowed |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | yes | 75.00 | 2 | 30 | not allowed |

## Cases (hypothetical plans)

- A KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary plan that has already been transferred once still has one transfer left of its 2; a KestrelCare Gold plan transferred once has used its only transfer.
- A KestrelCare Platinum plan on a vehicle sold privately on 2 May can have its transfer requested up to 1 June, the thirtieth calendar day after the sale.
- KestrelCare Powertrain shows no fee because it is not transferable.
